summary: In May 2023, Love sponsored Arkansas Senate Resolution 60, commending Israel on its 75th anniversary and affirming the Israeli people's right to defend their country. The resolution frames Israel's military conduct as an unqualified defensive right, shielding the state without acknowledging Palestinian harm.
